g.text: L-Eval | GPU staging occupancy | concurrency 16 | repeat 2
Qwen3-14B | 72 requests/run | 2 DRAM prefetch workers | 18 documents x 4 questions
Solid: sampled peak per 2s bin | Dashed: sampled mean per 2s bin
Y: allocated staging / configured capacity (%) X: seconds since each run started
All panels share the same axes. Runs end at different times; no zero padding or time normalization.
Sampled peaks may miss brief allocation spikes. Occupancy is not GPU compute utilization.
OFF disables only DRAM prefetch; DAOS prefetch remains enabled. Equal times do not imply equal requests.
